notes:
ARKhives 8.18.3 restores the study conversation and includes the prepared reviewer-card redesign.

- Fixed a missing desktop AI-attribution dependency that interrupted answer rendering before the laureate conversation could mount.
- Packaged and registered the AI label script, styles and provider images with the same device restrictions as other study assets.

Question text, answer keys, flashcard fronts/backs, images and personal learning progress are not modified by this UI repair. Research drafts and content publication remain separate. No physical iPhone/iPad test is claimed.
